contentHtml:
In the energetic city of Dubai, transforming your business idea into a reality can be an exciting venture if you are looking to set up a company on the mainland. Know that, this article is a guide for you that helps you make a well-informed decision. Dubai’s mainland is offering direct access to the local market and a prestigious business address. This beneficial place attracts entrepreneurs seeking a foothold in this thriving commercial hub. Understanding the cost of mainland company formation in Dubai is crucial for budgeting and planning your business setup.

As an aiming entrepreneur, you must determine the exact cost of setting up a mainland company in Dubai. We understand that it can be confusing due to various factors. But, we try to figure out how you can decide and budget wisely.

So, let’s get started and move on to the next section to help you explore the details:

Understand Mainland Company Setup in Dubai

In Dubai, a Mainland Company refers to establishing a business with a physical presence. The business under the mainland company operates within the onshore jurisdiction of the United Arab Emirates.

A mainland Company is registered by the Department of Economic Development. DED provides various business licenses for investors who wish to establish a company in UAE.

Advantages of Mainland company setup in UAE 2025

In this section, we share the several advantages of setting up a company in the mainland. This includes:

Broader Business Reach

The mainland companies can directly access the entire UAE market. Unlike Free Zones, with restrictions on mainland client interaction.

Greater Business Activity Freedom

The Mainland companies have a wider scope of permissible business activities. While Free Zone is limited to specific industries.

Location Flexibility

You can choose your office location anywhere in the UAE. As mainland offers operational freedom not restricted to designated Free Zone areas.

100% Foreign Ownership

Enjoy full ownership and control over your business without mandatory local partnerships required in some other jurisdictions.

Access to Government Contracts

Unlike Free Zones, mainland companies are eligible to participate in lucrative government tenders and contracts.

No Visa Limits (Generally)

The number of visas you can sponsor for employees isn’t restricted by quotas. However, Free Zones company formation has limitations.

Profit Repatriation

There are no restrictions on repatriating your business profits out of the UAE. This ensures full control over your finances.

Simpler Setup Process

The mainland company setup can involve a slightly streamlined process. On the other hand, some Free Zones have more complex regulations.

Factors Affecting Mainland Company Setup Costs in Dubai

Several key factors influence the overall cost of opening a company in the Dubai Mainland zone:

License type (Commercial, Professional, Industrial)

The Dubai mainland license cost in 2024 varies depending on your chosen license type, such as Commercial (most common), Professional (for specific professions), or Industrial (for manufacturing activities).

Business activity (specific permits may apply)

Certain business activities may require additional permits. This leads to increased costs. Research any specific permits needed for your chosen industry.

Number of visas required

The number of visas you sponsor for employees impacts the cost as each visa application incurs processing fees. As there are many visa services in UAE categories which depend on which type of visa you are providing/sponsoring for your staff

Choice of business support service package

The level of assistance you require from a business setup service provider affects the cost. Choose a package that aligns with your needs and budget.

Breakdown of Mainland Company Setup Cost in UAE

The mainland company setup in Dubai cost is broken down into two main categories:

Government fees

These include license fees, visa processing charges, and mandatory deposits.

Business support services

These are optional costs associated with professional assistance for tasks. The tasks include company registration, documentation, and legal advice.
